description: This file contains shell script commands and functions related to configuring DNAT port forwarding rules via UCI and iptables for a network device. It includes creating, verifying, and cleaning up port forwarding redirects.

methods.name: Create R alias
methods.description: Defines a shell alias 'R' wrapping around a remote command executor, configured via environment variable CRAM_REMOTE_COMMAND.

methods.name: Skip if uci missing
methods.description: Checks if the 'uci' command is available; if missing, outputs 'uci-missing' and exits.

methods.name: Parameters (overridable)
methods.description: Sets network parameters with default values if not already provided.

methods.name: Create redirect
methods.description: Creates a firewall redirect rule in UCI for port forwarding from WAN to LAN.

methods.name: Verify presence in nat PREROUTING
methods.description: Verifies that the port forwarding rule exists in iptables NAT PREROUTING chain.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Removes the created redirect rule from UCI configuration and reloads firewall.
